about: The sampler's English seeds per event kind (specs/scenario-sampler.md, version 1): 'concepts' are ways to name the act (the style card's 'terms' line picks one; the Arabic is the writer's); 'denied' and 'disputed' are the 'how' lines of a denied or disputed event (who says so, with what story); 'cause' are contests of the cause of a stated event (the proposition stands; the other side gives its own reason). Seeds, never wording, never a statement of the law. 'byClaim' overrides a list for one claim type. Written by the executor from the element's proposition (claim-elements.json) on 15 November 2026. 'disputedBy' says who disputes a disputed event and who contests a stated one: 'defendant' (the default), 'actor' (the party the event names as acting: the fact is against it), or 'notActor' (the other party: the fact is in the actor's favour); an unknown actor gives 'defendant'.

concepts: money handed over to be paid back
denied: the plaintiff's own account is that he only stood surety for the defendant's debt with a third party
disputed: the defendant says the money was a gift, not a loan
the defendant says he never received any money from the plaintiff
the defendant says the sum was the price of a car he sold to the plaintiff, not a loan

concepts: a signed acknowledgment of the debt
an IOU in the defendant's hand
a written admission of owing the sum
a recognition of the debt before witnesses
denied: the defendant never signed any paper recognising the debt
there is no acknowledgment of any kind, only the plaintiff's word
disputed: the defendant says the signature on the acknowledgment is not his
the defendant says he signed the paper under pressure and it records nothing real

concepts: the agreed date for paying back has come
the term for repayment has expired
the time given to the debtor is over
denied: the agreed term has not come yet: it falls later in the year
disputed: the defendant says the parties later agreed to extend the term, so it has not come
the defendant says no fixed date was ever agreed

concepts: the agreed delivery date has come
the term for handing over the goods has expired
the promised delivery day has passed
the time allowed to the seller is over
denied: the agreed delivery date has not come yet
disputed: the seller says the delivery date was pushed back by a later agreement
the seller says the contract fixed no delivery date

denied: no instalment at all was ever paid
not a single dinar was paid
disputed: the defendant says he paid a part in cash, which the plaintiff denies
the defendant claims a bank transfer that the plaintiff says never arrived

concepts: the price or an advance paid by the plaintiff
denied: the plaintiff paid nothing yet; the price was due on completion
disputed: the defendant says the advance was never received
the defendant says the money paid was for another job

concepts: the price paid by the plaintiff
the sum paid for the property
denied: the plaintiff has not paid the price yet
disputed: the defendant says the price was never paid in full
the defendant says the money received was a loan, not the price

concepts: the price or part of it paid by the buyer
a deposit paid to the seller
denied: the buyer has paid nothing yet
disputed: the seller says he never received the advance
the seller says the payment was smaller than the buyer claims

concepts: the unpaid balance of the loan
denied: the defendant paid everything back; only damages are at issue
disputed: the defendant says he repaid the whole sum
the defendant says the debt was settled by offsetting another debt
cause: the defendant admits he has not paid but blames a business loss
the defendant admits the balance but says the plaintiff agreed to wait

concepts: a demand served on the other side
a summons to pay or perform
a formal reminder of the obligation
denied: no notice of any kind was sent to the defendant
the client never warned the defendant formally
disputed: the defendant says he never received the notice
the defendant says the notice went to an old address and never reached him

concepts: the deal signed by both sides
disputed: the defendant says there were only negotiations and no contract
the defendant denies ever agreeing to anything

concepts: the transfer of the goods for a price
disputed: the defendant says the goods were left with him on trust, not sold
the defendant denies any sale

concepts: the letting of the premises and its monthly rent
disputed: the occupant says he lives there free of charge as a relative
the occupant denies any rental agreement

concepts: the letting of the premises for trade
disputed: the other side says the premises were lent, not leased
the other side says the lease covers only part of the shop
the seller says no sale was concluded, only a reservation
the seller denies the sale
the other side says the deal was an exchange, not a sale
the other side denies the transaction

concepts: the handing over of what was sold
denied: the goods have not been handed over yet
disputed: the defendant says he never received the goods
the defendant says only part of the shipment arrived

concepts: the goods or services provided on invoice
the deliveries made to the trader
disputed: the defendant says the delivery notes were not signed by his staff
the defendant says the goods invoiced were never delivered

concepts: the money due for the goods
denied: the seller was paid in full on the day of the deal
disputed: the defendant says he paid by bank transfer
the defendant says the price was settled in cash to a sales agent
cause: the defendant admits not paying but says the goods were defective
the defendant admits the debt but says he is waiting for a credit note

concepts: the months of rent not paid
the rent the tenant has stopped paying
denied: the tenant pays the rent regularly; the dispute is about the end of the lease
disputed: the tenant says he paid in cash without receipts
the tenant says he paid the rent to the owner's son
cause: the tenant admits the arrears but says he stopped paying because repairs were not made
the tenant admits not paying but blames the loss of his job

concepts: the thing promised not handed over
denied: the defendant delivered on time
disputed: the defendant says he put the goods at the buyer's disposal and the buyer never collected them
the defendant says delivery took place and shows a signed slip

concepts: the poor execution of the works
the halt of the building works
denied: the works are going on and have not stopped
disputed: the contractor says the works never stopped and are only slower
the contractor says the job was finished and handed over
cause: the contractor admits the stop but says the client did not let him on the site
the contractor admits the stop and blames late payments by the client

concepts: the delivery after the agreed date
denied: delivery took place on the agreed date
disputed: the defendant says the date was extended by agreement, so there was no delay
the defendant says he delivered on time
cause: the defendant admits the delay but blames a strike at the port
the defendant admits being late and says the plaintiff changed the order

concepts: a breach of another contractual duty
a failure to keep another promise of the contract
a violation of a clause of the agreement
denied: the defendant kept all his other obligations
disputed: the defendant denies any breach of the agreement
the defendant says the clause relied on does not exist

concepts: deceit that led to the contract
a trick used to obtain consent
disputed: the other side says he disclosed the problem before the signature
the other side says the plaintiff knew everything
the defendant denies being there at all
the defendant says someone else did it
cause: the defendant admits the act but says he acted in self-defence

concepts: a criminal judgment against the defendant
a conviction by the criminal court
denied: no criminal judgment exists: the complaint was shelved
disputed: the defendant denies that any judgment convicted him
the defendant says the judgment concerned another person of the same name

concepts: damage caused by something in the defendant's keeping
a water leak from the defendant's flat
an accident with the defendant's machine
harm done by the defendant's vehicle
denied: the thing was not in the defendant's keeping at the time
disputed: the defendant says the leak did not come from his flat
the defendant says the machine belonged to a neighbour

concepts: damage done by the defendant's animal
an attack by a guarded animal
denied: the animal was neither owned nor kept by the defendant
disputed: the defendant says it was not his dog
the defendant says his animal was tied up at home that day

concepts: the fall of part of a building
denied: no part of the building fell
disputed: the defendant says the collapsed wall is not his
the defendant says the wall belongs to the commune

concepts: the first day of the tenancy
denied: the tenant never received the premises
disputed: the defendant denies ever occupying the premises
the defendant says he moved in much later than the plaintiff says

concepts: the use of the house without right
disputed: the occupant says he has an oral lease
the occupant says the late father of the plaintiff gave him the house

concepts: the order to leave the premises
denied: the lessor never sent any notice to quit
disputed: the party it was addressed to says it never received the notice to quit
the party it was addressed to says the notice was served at a former address

concepts: the refusal to renew the lease
the lessor's no to a new term
the end of the tenancy by refusal
the rejection of the renewal request
denied: the lessor did not refuse renewal; he only asked for a higher rent
disputed: the other side says no refusal was ever made or notified
the other side says renewal was never asked for, so nothing was refused
the defendant denies that a marriage exists between them
the defendant says the marriage was never registered and is not valid

concepts: the separation decreed by the court
denied: no divorce has taken place: the couple is still married
disputed: the defendant says that divorce judgment was set aside on appeal
the defendant says no divorce was ever pronounced and the marriage still stands

concepts: the abandonment of the marital home
denied: the husband never left the marital home
disputed: the husband says it was the wife who left
the husband says he works abroad and still visits
cause: the husband admits leaving and says the wife's family drove him out

concepts: the refusal to provide for the family
the failure to support the wife and children
denied: the husband pays maintenance regularly
disputed: the husband says he sends money every month
the husband says he pays the children's school fees directly
cause: the husband admits not paying and pleads unemployment

denied: no harm is alleged; the claim rests on lack of maintenance alone
disputed: the husband denies ever hitting his wife
the husband says the medical certificate is about a fall

concepts: the parent the children stay with
the daily care of the children
denied: the children live with neither parent but with their grandmother
disputed: each parent says the children live with him or her
the other parent says the children moved to his home last month

concepts: the court decision that gave custody
denied: no judgment on custody was ever given
disputed: the defendant says that judgment was overturned on appeal
the defendant says the judgment concerned only one of the children

concepts: the earlier judgment that set visiting rights
the ruling fixing the visiting days
denied: no judgment on visits was ever given
disputed: the defendant says that judgment was overturned on appeal
the defendant says the judgment set other days

concepts: the custodian's new marriage to a stranger to the child
the new union of the custodian
denied: the custodian has not remarried since the divorce
disputed: the custodian says she is only engaged
the custodian says her new husband is the child's uncle

concepts: the custodian giving up the children
the handing back of the children
denied: the custodian never gave up custody
disputed: the custodian says the waiver was signed under pressure
the custodian says the paper was only about holidays

concepts: the child's schooling and health left aside
denied: the custodian looks after the child very well
disputed: the custodian denies any neglect and shows school reports
the custodian says the child's illness is being treated

concepts: more than a year without claiming custody
the long silence of the person entitled to custody
the failure to ask for the children
denied: the person entitled claimed custody as soon as he learned of the change
disputed: the father says he did not know the reason for the forfeiture
the father says he was abroad for medical treatment

concepts: the move abroad with the child
the plan to live outside Algeria
denied: the custodian has never left the country
disputed: the custodian says the trip is temporary, for medical care
the custodian says she only visits relatives abroad in summer

concepts: the refusal to let the parent see the children
the children kept away from the parent
denied: visits are not blocked; the plaintiff wants more of them
disputed: the other parent says the plaintiff simply does not come
the other parent says the children refuse to go
cause: the other parent admits blocking visits and says the plaintiff brought the children back late

concepts: the beginning of the work relationship
the first day at the company
disputed: the employer denies any employment and calls him a contractor
the employer says he was an intern, never an employee

concepts: the end of the employment by the employer
disputed: the employer denies firing him and says he walked out
the employer says the contract simply came to its end
cause: the employer admits the dismissal and says it was for repeated absence

concepts: the money due for work done
disputed: the employer says the wages were transferred to the worker's postal account
the employer says the worker was paid in cash and signed for it
cause: the employer admits the arrears and blames the company's cash problems

concepts: the failed attempt at the conciliation office
the conciliation report ending without agreement
the official finding of no settlement
denied: the dispute was never put before the conciliation office
disputed: the employer says the session ended in agreement
the employer says the record is a record of settlement, not of failure
